title: Carnegie Endowment for International Peace reports data breach
summary: As noted by Nextgov, the Carnegie Endowment for International Peace recently experienced a data breach involving a third-party vendor used for online donations.
why_it_matters: Breaches and cybercrime activity signal where attackers are focusing and what data types are actively monetized.
recommendation: Validate incident-response readiness, monitor for exposed credentials, and reinforce MFA, phishing resistance, and data-loss controls.

title: Ransomware recovery timelines and shifting attack tactics in 2026
summary: Ransomware recovery requires a median of 20 days for organizations to achieve full restoration, with nearly 30% of victims needing more than six weeks to return to normal operations, based on information published by Infosecurity Magazine.
why_it_matters: Ransomware operations combine disruption with extortion, making recovery speed and data-resilience core business risks.
recommendation: Verify offline backups, test restores, harden remote access, and review segmentation to limit lateral movement.
